steps.what: Determine the production document purpose and current process requirements
inputs: actual production process and document request

steps.what: Retrieve and reconcile actual batch, inventory and productivity data needed for the document
inputs: existing actual batch events, inventory transactions and production counts
outputs: checked source dataset and explicit gaps

steps.what: Draft the production document with linked figures and source-grounded procedure text
inputs: checked source dataset and explicit gaps
approved process instructions and current procedure version
outputs: complete production document draft with source links

loop.purpose: Propose procedure wording from approved instructions
loop.input: approved process instructions and current procedure version
loop.output: source-linked wording proposals with unresolved conflicts flagged
loop.check: Technician checks each instruction, sequence, warning and meaning against sources; figures are populated deterministically
loop.stop: Unspecified operation, conflicting instruction or unsupported claim goes to the engineer
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle figures; variable approved instruction prose needs source-grounded wording proposals

steps.what: Check every production figure and instruction against actual records and approved process requirements
inputs: complete production document draft with source links
checked source dataset and explicit gaps

steps.what: Approve the exact completed production document for saving as a reviewed draft
Save the reviewed production draft in the controlled document system
outputs: saved reviewed production draft awaiting required engineering release

tasks.design: Configure production extracts from {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP} into controlled templates in {DOCS}. Use a bounded wording proposal only for procedure prose, then verify every instruction and figure; the output remains a reviewed draft until the organisation's required engineering release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing production documents can require repeated source reconciliation and drafting from approved instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reports supply figures; a bounded source-linked wording step can propose variable procedure text.
tasks.still_hard: Process validity, safety-critical instructions and unresolved source conflicts require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician understands how the actual production process differs from a nominal description.

ambition.what: Prepare updated production documents when verified process records change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for production data and process-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: manufacturing systems can export production records, document templates can populate figures, and models can propose source-grounded prose subject to engineering review.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines.
Existing actual events and counts are produced by production operations; missing facts must be obtained and counted before rollout.
Native reports and controlled templates are configured first. Model prose is unnecessary for purely tabular records.
Saving in the same system is approximately zero today and receives no saving. Formal operational release is a distinct engineer-controlled workflow; this task prepares its reviewed draft.
Do not combine savings across document variants as if every document required all variants' work.
research_questions: Which preparation effort remains after native reports and controlled templates?

already_counted.description: Check figures and procedure meaning against actual sources

incremental.description: Maintain extract mappings, templates and source-grounding checks

approvals.approved_version: approved final reviewed production draft; edits require s5 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 hours in data preparation plus 15 in drafting =30. Three upkeep hours give central net 27%; five extra hours resolving source conflicts give high 22%. Low zero for already automated or source-poor document sets.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate equipment purchases, installation or transfers

steps.what: Confirm actual equipment requirements, location constraints and responsibilities
Inspect equipment purchase status, delivery dates and installation or transfer dependencies
Coordinate the equipment purchase, installation or transfer plan with responsible colleagues
outputs: agreed plan, owners, dates and unresolved conditions

steps.what: Capture the agreed actual plan, owners and dates in the equipment coordination record
inputs: agreed plan, owners, dates and unresolved conditions

steps.what: Prepare the coordination message with exact plan details and verified colleague recipients
Approve the completed equipment record and exact message and recipients
outputs: approved final equipment record and coordination message

steps.what: Send the approved coordination message to the exact internal recipients
inputs: approved final equipment record and coordination message

steps.what: Save the approved equipment coordination record
inputs: approved final equipment record and coordination message

tasks.design: Configure equipment status views in {ERP} and structured coordination records in {PROJECT}, with a native message template in {EMAIL}. People agree the plan and capture actual commitments before reviewing the completed record and message; the separate send and save receive no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status inspection, repeated equipment identifiers and coordination-message assembly can add work around actual discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked status views and record templates reuse existing equipment fields without inventing commitments.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating feasible downtime, responsibilities and installation constraints remains human.
tasks.human_edge: The technician reconciles practical dependencies between purchasing, production and facilities.

ambition.what: Review equipment readiness when dates or dependencies change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project and purchasing systems can provide equipment status views and structured records with reusable message templates.

assumptions: All arithmetic is a provisional scenario rather than an observed baseline.
Existing equipment and purchasing records supply identifiers and status; actual agreements are produced in s3 and captured in s4.
The 30% reduction in s4 is only repeated field selection and formatting; capture of actual owners and dates remains.
Native configuration first; already configured steps provide no additional saving.
This coordinates authorised work. Placing a purchase order and performing installation are distinct responsible-role actions, not hidden automated commitments.
Same-system save and short internal send are fully retained and have no saving.
unknowns: Existing native record and message templates
research_questions: Which record fields can be reused without assuming agreement?

already_counted.description: Check completed coordination record and exact message

incremental.description: Maintain status links, field defaults and message templates

approvals.approved_version: approved exact coordination message and recipients; changes return to s6
approved final equipment coordination record from s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 status hours +4.5 record-preparation hours +5 message-preparation hours =15.5. Upkeep 1.5 gives central net 14%; four extra hours reconciling stale equipment status gives high 10%. Low zero with current native coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select cleaning materials, tools or equipment

steps.what: Assess the actual cleaning purpose, surfaces, process conditions and material hazards
inputs: approved cleaning requirements and safety information

steps.what: Compare cleaning materials, tools and equipment against the verified selection constraints
inputs: existing approved product specifications and compatibility records
outputs: candidate comparison with unsupported compatibility flagged

steps.what: Evaluate practical suitability and any permitted trial before choosing the cleaning option
inputs: candidate comparison with unsupported compatibility flagged
actual use conditions and authorised trial observations
outputs: chosen cleaning option and actual selection reasons

steps.what: Prepare the selection recommendation using actual reasons and linked product fields
inputs: chosen cleaning option and actual selection reasons
candidate comparison with unsupported compatibility flagged

steps.what: Approve the completed selection recommendation and its evidence limits
Save the approved cleaning selection recommendation

tasks.design: Configure approved product comparisons in {PROCUREMENT} and a selection template in {DOCS}. Existing specifications populate factual fields; the technician checks compatibility, captures trial observations and authors the actual selection reasons before final approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing scattered specifications and formatting a recommendation can repeat work around the selection judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue fields and document templates can reuse approved product information.
tasks.still_hard: Site-specific suitability and uncertain material compatibility cannot be decided from missing catalogue fields.
tasks.human_edge: The technician understands the real production environment and recognises when specialist review is needed.

ambition.what: Make the existing cleaning selection easier to inspect and explain.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement catalogues and document templates can compare structured approved specifications and reuse those fields in a recommendation.

assumptions: Provisional work-design shares and savings, with no measured baseline claimed.
Approved specifications already exist; missing compatibility information remains an unresolved question.
Actual trials are performed only when authorised. Their observations and reasons are captured by the technician in s3 and s4.
No model infers safety compatibility. Native configuration comes first and the same-system save receives no saving.
research_questions: Which specifications can be compared without interpreting missing hazard information?

already_counted.description: Check the complete recommendation against constraints

incremental.description: Maintain approved comparison fields and template links

approvals.approved_version: approved final selection recommendation; edits require renewed s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 9 comparison hours +5.6 recommendation hours =14.6. One upkeep hour gives central net 13.6%; 3.6 extra hours checking incomplete specifications gives high 10%. Zero if native tools already cover the repeated work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate industrial hazardous-material and waste compliance

steps.what: Read the site's actual permits and approved hazardous-material or waste requirements
inputs: current site permits and approved obligations register
outputs: checked applicable requirement list with source links

steps.what: Inspect actual industrial generation, storage, treatment, transport and disposal practices within scope
inputs: checked applicable requirement list with source links
actual site operations and available operational records

steps.what: Capture actual observations and referenced operational evidence in the evaluation record
Evaluate the actual evidence against applicable requirements and write justified findings
inputs: checked applicable requirement list with source links
outputs: human-authored findings and unresolved compliance questions

steps.what: Assemble the evaluation report from captured evidence and human-authored findings
inputs: human-authored findings and unresolved compliance questions

steps.what: Check and approve the completed evaluation report against evidence and permit sources
inputs: checked applicable requirement list with source links

steps.what: Save the approved evaluation report in the compliance record

tasks.design: Configure source-linked permit retrieval in {DOCS} and evidence/report templates in the site's compliance system {OPS_SYSTEM}. The technician inspects operations, captures actual observations and evaluates compliance; templates assemble the report without inventing findings or interpreting new obligations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current source requirements and assembling an evidence-linked report can surround the substantive evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled document search and structured report fields can reuse the actual evaluation record.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, incomplete evidence and interpretation of a site's obligations need competent human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when observed practice conflicts with nominal records or requires specialist escalation.

ambition.what: Revisit an evidence-linked evaluation when operational conditions change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for site records and compliance-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document search and compliance record templates can link current requirements, observations and report fields without deciding compliance.

assumptions: This scenario supplies provisional shares, not measured inspection baselines or a legal opinion.
A competent owner supplies the actual applicable obligations register; s1 verifies current source versions rather than automatically interpreting new law.
Inspection and capture are separate s2 and s3, with no saving assigned to either.
Findings are authored in s4; native template assembly alone changes s5. Same-system save is retained at its minimum allocation with no saving.
The evaluation record is internal; an external regulatory submission would need its own completed payload, approval and separate send.
research_questions: Can each assembled report field be traced to an actual observation or source?

already_counted.description: Check the final report and its source support

incremental.description: Maintain controlled source links and report mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved final compliance evaluation report; changes return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 8 requirement-retrieval hours +3 report-assembly hours =11. Two upkeep hours give central net 9%; three additional hours resolving stale links give high 6%. Low zero for already configured systems or incomplete source coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
